# telnyx_room_client_token (Ephemeral Resource)

A client token that lets a participant join a video room, with the refresh token that renews it. Neither is ever stored in plan or state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A token a participant joins a video room with, minted on every run and
# never stored.
ephemeral "telnyx_room_client_token" "guest" {
  room_id        = telnyx_room.standup.id
  token_ttl_secs = 600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `room_id` (String) The room id.

### Optional

- `refresh_token_ttl_secs` (Number) The time to live in seconds of the Refresh Token, after that time the Refresh Token is invalid and can't be used to refresh Client Token. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `token_ttl_secs` (Number) The time to live in seconds of the Client Token, after that time the Client Token is invalid and can't be used to join a Room. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

### Read-Only

- `refresh_token` (String, Sensitive) The refresh token that renews the client token with `POST /rooms/{room_id}/actions/refresh_client_token`.
- `refresh_token_expires_at` (String, Sensitive) ISO 8601 timestamp when the refresh token expires.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The client token a participant joins the room with.
- `token_expires_at` (String, Sensitive) ISO 8601 timestamp when the token expires.
